'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Charlie Arlandson DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Charlie Arlandson]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?]]
* '''Username:''' Brazen
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
